draft.presenting_complaints: 66M male presented with increased breathlessness and wheeze for 3 days.
hospital_course: Admitted 11/08/2026 with SpO2 86% RA, pCO2 52 mmHg; started nebulisation Salbutamol + Ipratropium QID and IV Methylprednisolone 40 mg OD for 3 days.
Chest X‑ray 11/08/2026 showed hyperinflated lungs, no consolidation.
BiPAP used overnight; discontinued 13/08/2026 after SpO2 improved to 93% RA and wheeze reduced.
Doxycycline 100 mg BD started for possible infection.
Inhaler technique taught to patient and son on 14/08/2026.
draft.condition_at_discharge: Stable COPD with acute exacerbation, improved oxygenation, no active infection.
